'''2019 EGP Day 2 Joe Olson DS Combat Readiness''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Joe Olson]] at [[2019 Endor Grand Prix]] (Day 2).


== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[Joe Olson]]
* '''Event:''' [[2019 Endor Grand Prix]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Let Them Make The First Move / At Last We Will Have Revenge|Ref3-D-letthemmakethefirstmove.gif}}
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:Open Combat Readiness Olson DS 2019 EGP.txt |Download]]
* '''Format:''' [[Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
* '''Source:''' [https://www.starwarsccg.org/2019-endor-grand-prix/ PC list]. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20210127124159/https://www.starwarsccg.org/2019-endor-grand-prix/ Internet Archive]
